workerResult.summary: Steampunk drift computer: draggable brass helm dial + throttle/current/horizon levers plot a projected drift route on a procedural canvas archipelago with animated currents, reefs, landfall reckoning, and voyage-plan fixes. Page scroll stokes the boiler gauge, turns gears, sails a ghost ship along the route, and logbook chapters seize the helm. Share via URL-hash link, settings JSON, chart PNG, and captain's log .txt. No images — CSS/canvas only.
